environment: Rendered Linux native game, Mesa software OpenGL, virtual SDL Xbox controller; same sources cross-compiled for Windows x64
limits: Windows controller hardware and GPU require testing on the user computer.
Results cover the recorded scenarios; they do not guarantee absence of all gameplay bugs.
scope: Native animation candidate order retained; physical reach checked before committing a pass or shot.
Late per-leg reaching removed; residual drawn-shoe separation bounded at 8 cm, with rigid bone lengths and no additional ball impulse.
Standing chest preview anchored; complete swept shirt contact, authored recovery steps and exit after descent.
Assisted reception keeps longitudinal anticipation and lateral native reception choice.
Approved forward-loop entry uses the advancing toe and its planned entry cadence.
